facts.value: Decodes the command opcode and offers it first to Command_Execute. Unhandled opcodes are rebased by subtracting 10 and index one of two fighter callback tables; each handler receives the fighter GObj and mutable CommandInfo. The traversal-only variant instead reads a u8 length-table entry and adds that command-word count to the typed CmdUnion pointer. The stored value is not a byte-distance increment.
facts.rationale: Correct byte-versus-word terminology or the overbroad effect-free label. The source performs typed pointer arithmetic and still calls Command_Execute.

evidence.why: Two 49-entry FtCmd tables and one 49-entry u8 length table.
Three interpreter consumers and opcode rebasing.

The third interpreter skips fighter-specific handlers while still changing command timing and executing common commands, so it is not an effect-free interpreter.
